rounds.meaning: A life of duty and goodness, begun together
Love and devotion, free of fear and ego
Hearts full of longing for the Divine
Peace, harmony and a union that is whole

title: Bride
& Groom
meet.note: We met at a cousin’s Lohri bonfire, arguing about who made the better makki di roti. Six winters later we are still arguing, and we would not change a thing. Thank you for every blessing, every phone call and every bit of love along the way. We cannot wait to walk the laavan with all of you around us.

photos.alt: Harman and Simran walking through a mustard field at sunset
Sharing chai at a roadside dhaba
Simran twirling in an old haveli courtyard
Sitting by the lake among lit diyas
A tractor ride down a village road
